10k.note: 10-K (fiscal year 2024) describes an early-stage Nevada corporation in the nutraceutical / dietary supplements business with $139 of revenue in 2024, $49,404 in cash, going-concern doubt, and no manufacturing facilities yet built. Despite 'Biotech' in the corporate name, the issuer markets dietary supplements (a non-FDA-approved product class) and discloses no clinical-stage drug or device development, no IND, no NCT trial, and no regulated therapeutic pipeline.
